title: verify_peer data
description: Emitted when a handshake needs a user prompt (Strict or Quick mode per RFC007 §16.1). Client must respond with verify_response within 2 minutes. At most one prompt is open; a second handshake that needs a prompt is rejected without this event (busy). Unknown keys are also rejected without this event after 6 prompts in a rolling minute. stop_server and restart_server reject the pending prompts of peers that connected to the server; verify_response then fails with verification_not_found. peer_name is empty on the initiator. Name collision (unknown key, EqualFold with a stored name) sets name_collision and stored_name; the default button is Reject.

peer_name.description: The name the peer claimed. Empty on the initiator, who has not received a name yet.

stored_name.description: The name stored for this key, or the stored contact whose name the unknown key collides with.

name_collision.description: An unknown key claimed a stored peer's name (EqualFold).

own_code.description: Numeric fingerprint of the local identity key: 40 digits in eight groups of five.

peer_code.description: Numeric fingerprint of the peer's key: 40 digits in eight groups of five. This is the code to compare with the peer over a trusted channel.

safety_number.description: Pairwise SafetyNumber of both keys, for copy and paste.

known.description: Whether this peer is already in the known-peers list.
